description: Resize, move, rename, recolour or delete an artboard; notes holds a slide's speaker notes.

delete.description: true deletes the artboard and every shape on it (one undo step); links into it then go nowhere.

move_content.description: false moves the frame alone; by default its shapes and layouts move with it.

notes.description: Speaker notes for this slide or page: what the presenter says. They stay with the slide in the project and go into the PowerPoint export's notes. An empty string clears them.

tone.description: base, inverse (a dark page) or accent (a page in the accent colour); layouts built on it afterwards use that tone.

name: set_artboard
title: Edit artboard
